summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. In test/test_namespace.py, I added a NamespaceMembershipTest class covering prefix membership on Namespace and SH, closed membership for RDFS (positive, negative, plain-string and Literal negatives) and RDF (positive), and the container property rdf:_1 (False), plus imports for RDF, RDFS, SH, Namespace, and Literal. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the tests and doctests are unverified. No commits were made.
